criteria.evidence: The named real-listener consent flow completed sign-in, consent, code exchange and asset lookup. The existing browser session went directly to consent.
Cross-session and workspace decisions, sign-out, stale binding, denial and changed delegation exercised the durable decision results in the listener suite.
The protected listener required a valid bearer and current workspace permissions. The grant still served lookup after browser expiry or sign-out, and ceased to authorize after membership removal.
The composition refused separate namespaces before serving. Shared storage was exercised on independent instances.
The named command exercised memory, SQLite, PostgreSQL deadline rollback, a real PostgreSQL lock wait, a controlled retry and the already-approved grant after browser expiry.
